policy: The complete reviewed Catalog is authoritative after all HC decisions and their product fixes are incorporated. The target contains 65 independently covered Promises and Scenarios.
applicability: Catalog design and review only; it does not permit runtime semantic changes.

policy: Drive the real Files and Photos system pickers. Preauthorize persistent system permissions before an unattended run; a missing grant is a typed infrastructure interruption, never a product verdict or human prompt.
applicability: Files, Photos, local-network, hand-input, and world-sensing authorization at lane bootstrap.

policy: HDR10, HLG, and Dolby Vision acceptance uses exact metadata plus same-attempt project-generated positive and stripped-transfer negative references. Personal brightness, saturation, and aesthetic preference are outside automated coverage.
applicability: Visual dynamic-range obligations; invalid reference self-check makes the Oracle Indeterminate.

policy: Automated audio coverage includes measurable delivery, mute, renderer, discontinuity, overrun, channel-activity, codec, and synchronization facts. Subjective sound quality and post-render head-pose spatial perception are excluded.
applicability: App-observable audio output before system spatialization.

policy: Transition acceptance uses the typed transition ring, platform lifecycle deadlines, rollback state, and non-solid non-frozen frame sequences. Subjective comfort and abruptness are excluded.
applicability: Window, Portal, Docked, Panorama, and immersive transition attempts.

policy: Simulator Device Hub gaze-and-pinch plus ordered app-side spatialTap and toggle facts proves the product input pipeline. The missing physical-device actuator does not block automated coverage and subjective feel is excluded.
applicability: Simulator spatial-input lane only; device decode obligations remain independent.

policy: Use project-generated, acceptance-eligible 3840x2160 equirectangular 180-degree mono and stereo fixtures plus a same-resolution flat negative control. Geometry and eye separation are exact-field comparisons; comfort is excluded.
applicability: Projection and stereo corpus for 180-degree cases.

policy: Dolby Vision profiles 10 and 20 remain included. Supply them in an admitted MP4 or MKV form; do not add DASH or HLS solely for fixture reachability and do not drop the profiles.
applicability: Dolby Vision profile matrix on fixtures with acceptable provenance.

policy: Add an independent format-support Promise: unsupported codecs and unavailable decoders are identified before playback and produce typed, codec-specific guidance.
applicability: Graceful rejection; it cannot substitute for successful playback coverage.

policy: Add an independent issue-surface Promise. Every category has fixed title, actions, placement, and interruption policy; the product intentionally has one visible issue slot and a new issue replaces the previous issue.
applicability: User-visible issue policy, not an issue queue.

policy: A first open with no stored track preference starts with subtitles Off. Only an explicit stored preference or user selection may choose a track.
applicability: Subtitle selection on media-session open.

policy: A source-declared panoramic format first settles in Portal. Panorama requires an explicit public entry action; observing either outcome is not acceptable.
applicability: Clean first open and persisted format overrides.

policy: The closed loading vocabulary is none or loading. Opening and true playback starvation show Loading; a reconnect completely covered by buffered media never shows it.
applicability: Remote open, reconnect, and renderer-starvation windows.

policy: Play Next under Ask Every Time does not interrupt continuous playback with a resume prompt. It continues from the stored position according to the queue action.
applicability: Automatic end-of-media Play Next only; a direct user open still honors Ask Every Time.

policy: Clear All Playback Progress clears viewing progress and completion only. Format, presentation-mode, and track preferences remain.
applicability: The Playback Progress settings action.

policy: Deleting a library folder removes the folder hierarchy but moves contained media references to the deleted root folder's parent. Original source files remain untouched.
applicability: Library-folder deletion; deleting a media reference remains a separate action.

policy: Video format editing is available in Window and Portal only. Docked exposes placement controls instead, and Panorama exposes neither editor.
applicability: Playback panel settings hosts.

policy: Retire all legacy perceptual Not Applicable rows. Absence of an obligation represents absence of automated coverage; no runtime not-applicable verdict exists.
applicability: Legacy vp-e2e perceptual design notes.

policy: For the locked Emby server, network, device, and fixture environment, click-to-first-changing-frame must be at most 45000 ms. The harness liveness deadline is 90000 ms and is not the product threshold.
applicability: Cold Emby open in the recorded controlled environment; warm-open performance is measured separately.

policy: Add five independent library-management Promises for folder naming, folder deletion and reference rehoming, moving references, confirmed batch deletion, and current-folder search/counts; add one playback-queue Promise for end behavior and resume-policy interaction.
applicability: Library and automatic playback queue behavior; import remains a separate Promise family.

policy: Apple Immersive support requires successfully decoded, changing rendered frames with the correct immersive projection. Classification or typed rejection cannot satisfy the Promise.
applicability: Apple Immersive media with an acceptance-eligible asset.

policy: Compare exact causal values first. Only unavoidable uncertainty uses a named versioned rule keyed by producer, fixture, lane, and environment. Emby ticks use product rounding, artwork JPEG uses a measured distortion bound, reconnect observation uses a versioned sampling interval, and resume position uses a 5-second observed-position bound after exact target binding.
applicability: All rubric numeric comparisons; no global tolerance exists.

policy: Source connection guidance has exactly four typed outcomes: credentials-rejected, server-unreachable, invalid-address, and requires-https. Wrong username and wrong password intentionally share credentials-rejected.
applicability: SMB, WebDAV, and Emby connection forms before playback.

policy: Active playback failures have exactly four typed categories: connection-interrupted, source-file-missing, source-access-denied, and media-data-corrupt. Every category preserves the causal position and exposes Retry and Close; Retry resumes within the HC-021 bound. Generic playbackFailed is insufficient.
applicability: Failures after active playback begins; connection-form failures use HC-022.
